poster.title: Turkey Takeover menu and share poster
poster.method: Created with ImageGen and exported as a 1200 × 630 JPEG for the lobby and link previews.
poster.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Make the finished wide landscape 1.91:1 Open Graph link preview for the playful Colorado chase game Turkey Takeover. A masterfully drawn vintage Colorado park-travel screenprint with strong flat cut-paper shapes, restrained stipple and subtle tooth, confidently designed as one bespoke poster. In the left half huge two-line condensed slightly slanted sign-painter lettering exactly “TURKEY” over “TAKEOVER”, crisp cream and ochre gold lettering over deep pine-green ink. The title is the only writing; keep every letter and the main face comfortably inside the central 82% of the canvas vertically. In the right half an expressive Bourbon Red tom in mid-stride in profile facing left, chestnut plumage, a characterful dusty-blue head, red wattle and a bold flared cream-tipped tail fan. It is chasing a small recognizable anthropomorphic slice of pumpkin pie topped with whipped cream running away below the title, little motion dashes for a witty action beat. Behind them, the sharply tilted slabs of the Boulder Flatirons and simplified pines in layered ochre, brick, dusty blue and dark spruce, late-afternoon autumn light. Dynamic diagonal landscape, instantly legible silhouette, beautifully integrated handmade illustration and title. Full bleed, no margin or frame. No extra writing, slogans, seals, logos, UI or watermarks.

touchIcon.title: Turkey Takeover icons
touchIcon.method: A close crop of the illustrated turkey’s face from the menu and share poster, exported at 180 × 180 for the Apple touch icon and 32 × 32 for the favicon.

originalPhotoCover.title: Turkey Takeover cover photograph composite
originalPhotoCover.changes: The turkey was isolated, resized and composited over cropped landscape photographs. Color and contrast were adjusted across the image.
